hero.caption: Air Force Senior Airman Curtis Towne salutes as he returns home from Hainan on April 12, 2001.  He was a crewmember on the U.S. Navy EP-3 aircraft that was involved in an accident with a Chinese F-8 aircraft on April 1, 2001.
hero.alt: Air Force Senior Airman Curtis Towne salutes as he returns home from Hainan on April 12, 2001.  He was a crewmember on the U.S. Navy EP-3 aircraft that was involved in an accident with a Chinese F-8 aircraft on April 1, 2001.
